items.title: Terry McLaurin: Seemingly game-time decision for Week 5
items.body_text: McLaurin (hamstring), who is officially questionable for Sunday's game against the Giants, will be a game-time decision, as Jeremy Fowler of ESPN highlighted Friday in a Week 5 injury update on SportsCenter. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: DJ Moore: Remains sidelined Friday
items.body_text: Moore (shoulder) remained a non-participant in Friday's practice for the Bills. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Jeremiyah Love: Set to play Sunday
items.body_text: Love (ankle) doesn't have a designation for Sunday's contest versus the Lions, Theo Mackie of The Arizona Republic reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Mike Evans: Cleared for Week 5
items.body_text: Evans (ribs) does not have an injury designation for Sunday's game against the Seahawks, Nick Wagoner of ESPN.com reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Dallas Goedert: Ready to return in Week 5
items.body_text: Goedert (knee) doesn't have a designation for Sunday's game versus the Jaguars in London. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
